plan.title: Mastering Tricky Word Spellings
plan.focus: Correcting common double-letter spelling errors like necessary and beginning

steps.teacher: The teacher writes the word necessary on the board and highlights the single c and double s to show where students often misspell it.
steps.students: The students look at the highlighted letters and repeat the spelling out loud together.

steps.teacher: The teacher explains the rule of one coffee cup has one c and two s's for necessary, and a double n for beginning.
steps.students: The students copy the rule into their notebooks and underline the tricky double letters.

steps.teacher: The teacher writes misspelled words on the board and asks the class to spot the errors.
steps.students: The students raise their hands to identify the missing or extra double letters in the presented words.

steps.teacher: The teacher dictates two new challenge words and circulates the room to check student spelling.
steps.students: The students write the dictated words independently in their notebooks.

hingeQuestion.question: Which of these is the correct spelling: neccesary, necassary, or necessary?
hingeQuestion.ifWrong: If students choose the wrong spelling, write the word again and have them count the c's and s's out loud.

support.question: Spell the word for a requirement: neccessary / necessary
Spell the word for starting something: beginning / begining
Spell the word for a place with books: library / libary
Spell the word for coming after: tomorrow / tommorrow

stretch.question: Spell the word meaning independent: independent / independant
Spell the word meaning persistent: persevere / persevear

notes.text: Dear Parent, {{student}} scored {{score}} out of {{total}} on our recent English check. We noticed a few spelling errors with tricky words like necessary and beginning. Please help your child practice writing these words three times each night using flashcards to build confidence.

प्रिय माता-पिता, {{student}} ने हमारे हालिया अंग्रेजी परीक्षण में {{total}} में से {{score}} अंक प्राप्त किए। हमने देखा कि 'necessary' और 'beginning' जैसे कठिन शब्दों की वर्तनी में कुछ गलतियाँ हुईं। कृपया फ्लैशकार्ड की मदद से इन शब्दों को रोज रात तीन बार लिखने का अभ्यास करवाएं।

அன்பார்ந்த பெற்றோருக்கு, {{student}} எங்கள் சமீபத்திய ஆங்கிலச் சோதனையில் {{total}} மதிப்பெண்களுக்கு {{score}} பெற்றுள்ளார். necessary மற்றும் beginning போன்ற கடினமான வார்த்தைகளின் எழுத்துக்கூட்டல்களில் சில பிழைகள் இருந்தன. ஃப்ளாஷ் கார்டுகளைப் பயன்படுத்தி ஒவ்வொரு இரவும் இந்த வார்த்தைகளை மூன்று முறை எழுதிப் பயிற்சி செய்ய உதவுங்கள்.
